Exercise 6 — Create Academic Noun Phrases 
Combine the words to form sophisticated noun phrases: 
1. development / youth / socio-cognitive

IELTS Discussion Essay Topic 
Some people believe that the media has a predominantly negative 
influence on young people, while others argue that it provides 
valuable opportunities for learning and connection. Discuss both views 
and give your own opinion.
